description: Use this when an SDK client calls a remote API with documented rate limits (HTTP 429, gRPC RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) and needs token-bucket pacing, Retry-After honouring, and per-method vs per-client scope decisions. Covers golang.org/x/time/rate, ctx-aware Wait, and adaptive shaping. Triggers: rate.Limiter, token bucket, leaky bucket, Retry-After, rate.NewLimiter, Wait(ctx), Allow().
